title: The Stone Circle
text: "Sky-walker. You came down in fire and burned nothing. That is new."

lines.text: "I am the Marro. I keep the songs. The songs say others came like you, in a shell that opened like a flower."
"They say a lot of other things. Not to strangers."

choices.label: Stay and listen anyway
choices.reply: We stay at the edge of the stones until the fire is low. The Marro hums, not singing, not stopping. It sounds like counting.

choices.label: Leave a gift of alloys
choices.reply: Sixty alloys of cut plate, left on the flat stone. The Marro taps one with a knuckle and smiles at the sound.

choices.label: Ask about the south
choices.reply: "The burned ground. The children don't go there. Go, if you must. Then come back and tell me what you saw."
